translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, awibo bam mz nabznge atwrnrngr.
X angrlvzx nim mz mz kxnzmatqng.
Lxlvrkibo Mangr-nzangiongr nim mz nzglqlz-krnge drtqm.
X awi-ngrbo bam nqmq krm,
Nzaodu-krm, x nzangidati-krm.
Murde drtqm x natqm nzmyatxpx-esz'ngr.
Mzli kc tqkrka'-ngrbo bam, ayzlume natqnge,
Mz nzaetunepx-krm nzxplr-krnge.
Yawe, king amrlx mz nrlc sa naglqlzlr nim,
Mz nzxlr-krdr nzmrlzkr natqm.
X sa na-angrlvzlr kxmu nzale-krmqng da,
Mz nzmc-krdr kx myatxlz-esz'ngrn.
Kxmule-esz' myalz-esz'ngrn, a' sc tqaclve-zvzq kxnzavzo-lzbqng.
X avzome kxnzglqpx-lzbqng.
X kxmule-esz' nzkxpungr nzprtzmqng bange, a' amnc-zpwxq ninge.
X tu-zvzme mz nibrnge mz nzngyatikr drtwr enqmi rngeng ninge.
X arlapxq ninge mz zmatq ngrm.
Yawe, krlzx kx sa na-angidatiq drtwr amrlx kcng tqyrlq-pz'liti-ngrn ninge.
Murde nzaodu-krm tqyc tqyc.
Bzkq esaki nzaclve-krm krkcng amrlx tqwz-ngrn.
